# Microsoft Entra Domain Services

A managed domain with hardened security settings, in a dedicated subnet. Provisioning continues for up to an hour after the deployment returns.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|
| [pContext](#pcontext) | yes | [contextType](#contexttype) |
| [pDomainServices](#pdomainservices) | yes | [domainServicesType](#domainservicestype) |
| [pSubnetId](#psubnetid) | yes | string |

### pContext

Where the managed domain is deployed.

- Type: [contextType](#contexttype)

### pDomainServices

The managed domain. A tenant can have only one.

- Type: [domainServicesType](#domainservicestype)

### pSubnetId

Resource ID of the dedicated subnet. It needs a network security group that allows the management traffic.

- Type: string

## Types

### contextType

Where a resource is deployed. Every module takes it as pContext.

| Property | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| environment | yes | [environmentType](#environmenttype) | Environment short name, used in every resource name. |
| location | yes | [regionType](#regiontype) | Azure region of the resources. |
| tags | no | object | Tags added to every resource. Example: `{"workload":"sample-app","owner":"platform-team"}` |

### domainServicesType

A Microsoft Entra Domain Services managed domain. A tenant can have only one.

| Property | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| domainName | yes | string | DNS name of the managed domain. Use a domain you own. Example: `aaddscontoso.com` |
| sku | yes | string | Size of the managed domain. Allowed values: `Enterprise`, `Premium`, `Standard` |
| notifyEmails | no | string[] | Email addresses notified about alerts on the managed domain, on top of the domain admins. Example: `["platform-team@contoso.com"]` |

### environmentType

Environment short name. Each environment has its own management group hierarchy and subscriptions.

- Type: string
- Allowed values: `dev`, `prod`

### regionType

Azure regions this platform deploys to. Each one has a short code in regionCode().

- Type: string
- Allowed values: `switzerlandnorth`, `switzerlandwest`, `westeurope`

| Output | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
